comparison.objective: Feed a laminating pouch sealed-edge-first and square into powered rollers.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and present a thin sheet to a slot, then release at the roller bite.
comparison.success_condition: Square sealed-edge bite and complete draw-through without an open-edge jam or continued gripping.
comparison.reason: Roller feeding and release timing do not test bimanual striking, notch fracture, retained-coil protection, or fragment collection.
